_what: Which tokenized-equity venues this project measures, which it does not, and why. The verdict that matters is depth_readable_from_public_state: whether the quantity I publish can be read from public contract state by anyone, without an account. A venue where it cannot is not a venue I publish depth figures for, and saying why is the deliverable in that case.
_rule: A venue naming measurement paths must have depth_readable_from_public_state == "yes". A venue whose verdict is anything else must name none. Every directory under measurements/ is either named by a venue row or listed in not_venue_depth, so nothing can sit in this tree unclassified. Enforced by check K in code/check_published.py.

_source_kinds.measured: read by me from public state; the artifacts are in this repository
_source_kinds.announcement: taken from a public announcement and NOT independently verified by me; no claim about actual depth is made or implied

venues.reason: pool state is readable by anyone from the public endpoint; the constraint here is retention rather than permission - the public endpoint keeps only minutes of state, so historical rounds need an archive and that is disclosed with the series
Uniswap v3-shaped pools; reserves, tick bitmap and per-tick liquidity are readable at a pinned block hash with requireCanonical, by anyone, with no account

no enumerable on-chain registry was found for this issuer's token set; addresses are reachable only by cross-chain identity, so the venue set cannot be enumerated reproducibly and no depth figure is published

announced 2026-10-08 with three properties that each remove the readable quantity: access is gated behind KYC and a qualified-investor test, so a quote cannot be obtained without an account; trading runs on the issuer's own proprietary AMM rather than a pool whose reserves are public; and liquidity is provided by a designated market maker, which means the depth is a quote that exists off-chain for milliseconds rather than a reserve that can be read. The honest deliverable for a venue like this is not a number, it is the finding that its depth is not independently verifiable, with the reason stated

venues.venue: Pendle PT market for ORBIO on Robinhood Chain
venues.reason: the market's whole state is one readState call and the pricing curve is closed form, so a quote is arithmetic rather than a walk; reads pin by block hash with requireCanonical, which this endpoint honours - a forged hash returns 'header not found'. The constraint is retention, not permission: state survives only minutes on the public endpoint, so a pre-expiry capture cannot be made after the fact and is archived at the time instead

note: The two halves of this file are the point. Depth that can be read from public state is becoming a property of the permissionless venues rather than an industry norm: a regulated venue's disclosure is auditable by its regulator, which is not the same as verifiable by a reader. Nothing here says the permissioned venues are worse or thinner - I cannot measure them, and that is the finding.
not_venue_depth_note: These directories hold measurements that are not a venue's depth. measurements/pendle-market-logs is the clearest case: it is an archive of the raw event logs two PT markets emitted, captured because this chain keeps state for minutes and the trades are the only surviving record of what anyone actually paid. It carries no depth figure and makes no claim about either market's depth; what it is for is to make a later counterfactual quote checkable against a real trade.
